scope: Controlled unsolved 3D heated fluid pipe and fluid/solid wall API evidence; development samples, not independent accuracy evaluation
limitations: No mesh or solver was run; repeated static reads do not establish physical correctness or convergence.

Controlled z-axis circular cylinders and concentric wall only; geometry roles require topology, sampled curvature/normals and API-measured area/volume checks; native curved measurements differ from analytic values by approximately 0.51%, so the adapter permits 1% measure error while shape checks use 1e-7 relative tolerance.
Surface parameter grids may include points outside trimmed faces; API-measured entity measures and edge evidence are retained for conservative validation.
